say:0:1720960001:1.text: Demit used a public works project as cover to siphon money from the newspaper, buy supplies for boat repairs, and hire a boatman. Everything he did points to one conclusion: he was preparing to escape by water.
say:0:1720960001:1.source_cn: 德米特子爵以市政工程为名，挪用报社资金，购买修缮船只的...
